verdict.rationale: Antigravity has a dedicated Skills system: docs describe creating/downloading customizable skills, a SKILL.md folder format, plugins that bundle skills/rules/MCP/hooks, and slash-command access to skills configuration in the CLI and SDK. This is first-party documentation of a concrete, well-specified custom-skill mechanism rather than a vague claim. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation of authoring and using a custom skill (community evidence covers other topics like security and stability, not skills specifically).
